scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I'll start explaining the operation. First of all...
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我來說明一下作戰計劃。
首先...

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I'll start explaining the operation. First of all...
...... now you can run wild.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我來說明一下作戰計劃。
首先...
...接下來，你們就放手大幹一場吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Something seems to have exploded over there. The flames have risen from the front!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
那邊好像有什麼東西炸了，前方起火了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There are 4 identified locations these explosion came from! I have ^FF0000shown them on your minimap.^000000
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
已確認有4處爆炸地點！我已經^FF0000在你的小地圖上標出了位置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
It's quite sudden but, I'm changing the operation.
Don't worry about those already at the front, they adjust to any situation.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
事發突然，作戰計劃要變更。
不用擔心已經抵達前線的同伴，他們能隨機應變。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Divide into 4 teams, everyone at their own locations and start suppressing the leads. If any team finds Elyumina, let us know immediately.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
分成4組，各自到指定地點展開壓制。
哪一組發現艾露米娜，立刻報告！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Everyone, to your position! Start the operation!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
全員就位，開始行動！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I ask you to act separately adventurer. Please check your ^0000CDminimap^000000 to organize the situation as quickly as possible. Join the team if they need support!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
冒險者，請你單獨行動。
檢視^0000CD小地圖^000000，儘快掌握局勢。
哪一組需要支援，就去幫忙！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The briefing... the criminal here will be the one to do it.
It's hard to babysit criminals.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
作戰說明...就交給這裡的罪犯來講吧。
照看罪犯可真夠累的。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Haha! Isn't that your job? Do it properly. Why are you leaving the briefing to me?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
哈哈！那不是你的工作嗎？好好幹啊，為什麼把作戰說明推給我？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
So noisy. Before we get started. Are you part of the USU now?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
真吵。
開始之前先問一句，你現在也是USU的一員了吧？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
That, that's what he said... are you afraid that I'll be scared!
Heh, I'll do the explaining because I want to take care of my children!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
他、他是這麼說過...你以為我會怕嗎！
哼，我來講就是了，誰讓我放心不下孩子們呢！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... Okay, it's almost time.
My children will start setting up traps in <TIPBOX>[four places]<INFO>8086</INFO></TIPBOX>.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...好了，時間差不多了。
我的孩子們將在<TIPBOX>[四個地點]<INFO>8086</INFO></TIPBOX>開始佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Here, take the map. The information will also be delivered to the party members as well.
You aren't alone right? You know my children are powerful?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
拿著地圖，隊員們也會收到同樣的資訊。
你不是一個人來的吧？我的孩子們有多厲害，你知道的吧？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Go ahead and touch the traps. The traps will activate and my lovely children will appear.
You do remember how the traps work, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
去觸碰陷阱吧。陷阱會啟用，我可愛的孩子們就會出現。
你記得陷阱是怎麼運作的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
After you've cleared the four traps, EL1_A17T will come out, and this lady here will bring you to the same place as last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
清除四個陷阱後，EL1_A17T會出現，這位女士會帶你們去和上次一樣的地方。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
That's it for the explanation. Now, get to work! Muscle idiots! Ahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
說明完畢，快去幹活吧！一群滿腦子肌肉的笨蛋！啊哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
...I'll have a conversation with this criminal in a bit... Anyways. I'm counting on you, adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
...待會兒我得和這個罪犯好好談談...
總之，拜託你們了，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
That was fast... It was expected that my kids wouldn't win though.
There's a lot more trouble going on up there~
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
真快...本來也沒指望我的孩子們能贏。
上面還有很多麻煩事呢~

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... are you going straight for my EL1-A17T?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...你是直接衝著我的EL1-A17T去的嗎？

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Don't go in yet.
scripts.translation: 先不進入

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Come on, I was about to open it.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
真是的，我都準備開門了。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Hahaha! Yes. Let's work hard. Gather more battle data for me!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
哈哈！沒錯。好好幹吧。替我收集更多的戰鬥資料！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There is a suspicious box! A signal is being transmitted from the inside, it's currently being decrypted!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
發現可疑箱子！裡面有訊號傳出，正在解密！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Destroy the Biological Battery and kill the monsters!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
摧毀生物電池並消滅魔物！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Sorry for the late analysis. It wasn't a device to summon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
抱歉，這麼晚才分析出來。
這東西並不只是召喚魔物的裝置。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
After summoning the monsters, it summons a bio-battery to strengthen the monsters and explodes.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
它召喚魔物後，還會放出生物電池強化魔物，然後爆炸。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
If you want to handle it, just destroy it. It's good because it's a simple solution.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
要解決它，直接砸掉就行，倒也省事。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Well, it looks like this is over....
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
嗯，看來這裡處理完了...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
It looks like you've found something interesting here. You should check out the other teams!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
看來你在這裡發現了有趣的東西。
去看看其他小組的情況吧！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
The cause of the explosion is unknown, but I've found this suspicious box at the site. It seems to be some type of mechanism.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
爆炸原因不明，但我在現場發現了這個可疑的箱子。它似乎是某種機械裝置。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There is a signal being transmitted from the inside... Huh, be careful. Something's happening!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
裡面有訊號傳出來...咦，小心，有動靜！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Destroy the Biological Battery and kill the monsters!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
摧毀生物電池並消滅魔物！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There is a suspicious box! A signal is being transmitted from the inside, it's currently being decrypted!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
發現可疑箱子！裡面有訊號傳出，正在解密！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Avoid the Chemical Poison and kill the monsters!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
避開化學毒氣並消滅魔物！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
It's an awful but interesting device. It wasn't a device meant to summon monsters.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
這裝置真夠惡毒的，不過也挺有意思。
它並不只是用來召喚魔物的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
After summoning monsters, it constantly releases chemical poison, making it even more difficult to remove the monster.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
召喚魔物後，它還會不斷釋放化學毒氣，讓魔物更難對付。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
If you touch the chemical poison, it will spread like bomb. You shouldn't get any closer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
一旦碰到化學毒氣，毒氣就會像炸彈爆炸一樣擴散。
千萬別靠近。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
So, it looks like this is over, I'll go join another team! You should too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
好，看來這裡處理完了，我去和其他小組會合！你也來吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
The cause of the explosion is unknown, but I've found this suspicious box at the site. It seems to be some type of mechanism.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
爆炸原因不明，但我在現場發現了這個可疑的箱子。它似乎是某種機械裝置。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There is a signal being transmitted from the inside... Huh, be careful. Something's happening!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
裡面有訊號傳出來...咦，小心，有動靜！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Avoid the Chemical Poison and kill the monsters!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
避開化學毒氣並消滅魔物！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
.....

[Rebellion]
.....

[Rebellion]
.....
- Smoke is rising from the suspicious box. -
scripts.translation: - 可疑的箱子正在冒煙。-

scripts.text: Have you done this already?
scripts.translation: 你已經做過這個了嗎？

scripts.text: Are you still silent?
scripts.translation: 你還是不說話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
.....

[Rebellion]
*Nods, nods*
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
*點了點頭*

scripts.text: - Let's go support another team. -
scripts.translation: - 我們去支援另一支隊伍吧。-

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Did I tell you that I'm really happy working with the Secret Wing? Thanks to them, I was chosen for this operation.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我說過嗎？能和秘密之翼一起行動，我真的很高興。
多虧了他們，我才能參加這次行動。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Let's show them what we're all about, and that we're good guys.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
讓他們見識一下我們的本事，也讓他們知道我們都是好樣的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I haven't seen you in a while adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
好久不見，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I already know you adventurer, but please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我知道你的本事，冒險者，不過還是要小心。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Hello adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
It was nice to be part of this squad, we've already taken care of this box.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
能加入這支小隊真不錯，這個箱子已經處理好了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
These machines uses chemical poison, be careful.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
這些機器使用化學毒氣，請小心。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
We will now conduct our search, until the signal comes. Adventurer, be careful!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我們現在開始搜尋，直到收到訊號為止。冒險者，請小心！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I've been waiting for you. I've found the crazy researcher.
The other guys are surrounding the place.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
等你很久了，已經找到那個瘋子研究員了。
其他人正在包圍那裡。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
In order to control such a machine in such a fine manner, Elyumina must be around.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
能把這臺機器操控得這麼精細，艾露米娜肯定就在附近。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
It would be possible for me to handle this machine, but then I wouldn't be able to catch Elyumina.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我雖然能處理這臺機器，但那樣就沒法抓住艾露米娜了。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
If you take care of the machine, the other search parties will take care of finding Elyumina.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
如果你負責處理機器，其他搜尋小組就會負責尋找艾露米娜。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The Rebellion squad is well coordinated, this work will be best suited for us. So leave that task to us.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
反叛者小隊配合默契，搜捕最適合我們。
這個任務就交給我們吧。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The place we'll enter will be at 9 o'clock. I confirmed that nobody was hiding there, and we blocked the exits.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
入口在9點鐘方向。
我確認過那裡沒人埋伏，也已經封鎖了出口。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Give me a signal when you're ready to get in. I'll tell the squad to let you in.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
準備好進去就給我訊號，我會通知小隊放行。

scripts.text: Give signal.
scripts.translation: 發出訊號

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Yes it's a dangerous opponent to face. I'm sorry to have to leave you alone to fight. Let me know when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
是的，對手非常危險。抱歉只能讓你獨自戰鬥。準備好了就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Okay, watch out! I opened the portal so that you can go in. It's a one way entry, so make sure you're prepared!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
好，小心點！傳送門已經開啟，可以進去了。
這是單向通道，一定要做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Oh, yes. You've worked hard again this time. It's quite tough! How long do we have to use that scrap of metal for it to stop?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
哦，對了，這次又辛苦你了。
真夠難纏的！那堆廢鐵還要折騰我們多久才肯停下來？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Didn't I say not to call it scrap of metal?! You idiot!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我不是說過不要叫它廢鐵嗎？你這個笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Yeah yeah, it wasn't a scrap metal at first. But now we've caught it, it's scrap metal. Anyway, you've worked hard. You go back and rest now.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
是是是，原本不是廢鐵，可現在既然被我們拿下了，那就是廢鐵。
總之，辛苦你了，回去休息吧。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Stay for a moment.
scripts.translation: 再待一會兒

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Alright, let me know when you're ready to go out.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
好的，準備好出去時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Good job. It's funny that we have to do this again tomorrow. See you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
辛苦了。
說來也好笑，明天還得再來一遍。
明天見。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Well done, {0}. The operation was a success!
I ran away also, It's quite embarrassing since you knocked down that huge scrap of metal. I also captured something mesmerizing.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
幹得好，{0}，行動成功了！
你把那麼大一堆廢鐵都打倒了，我卻跑開了，真有點不好意思。
不過我也抓到了個有意思的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Scrap metal! It's a masterpiece! My great child!
You! You... hurt my child! You destroyed my child!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
什麼廢鐵！那可是傑作！我了不起的孩子！
你！你...傷了我的孩子！你毀了我的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Did you just call those scraps children?
Well, your children are probably good. Then let's go pay the price for your children's mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
你管那些廢鐵叫孩子？
好吧，你的孩子可真了不起。
走吧，該為你那些孩子犯的錯付出代價了。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
What are you going to do now {0}?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
{0}，你現在打算做什麼？

scripts.text: I'm going right back.
scripts.translation: 我馬上回去

scripts.text: I'll stay here for a bit
scripts.translation: 我在這裡待一會兒

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Alright, let me know when you're ready to go out.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
好的，準備好出去時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Good work. We'll be clearing things up here, you can take a break. I'm going to interrogate her. Take a break and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
辛苦了，這裡由我們收拾，你去休息吧。
我要審問她，等你休息好了再來找我。
